title: Wall Mount Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass For Bathroom | Polished Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Keep essentials within reach while saving space with this wall mount retractable hooks and garment rod in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then retracts when not in use—ideal for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Supports up to 15 lb for coats, robes, and towels
- Swap the included knob tip with your own cabinet knob to coordinate with minimalist bathroom fixtures
- Wall mount installation saves floor space

Specs & installation:
- Fits standard interior walls
- Mounting hardware included; uses 6/32 toggles
- Drilling required: 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L; projection 1"
- Multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors
